qdrantFields.urlHint: The instance's address with its port, as Qdrant Cloud shows it or your own deployment serves it.
qdrantFields.apiKeyHint: Leave empty for an instance without one. A secret reference, such as ${secret:NAME}, is resolved when the source is read.
qdrantFields.grpcHint: Reads through Qdrant's gRPC port instead of its REST port.
